variant_descriptions.fno: Standard FNO baseline (physical grid, identical backbone)
variant_descriptions.dif-certified: DIF-FNO with Lipschitz-capped residual: det J >= (1-L)^2 by construction
variant_descriptions.dif-nobar: Ablation: unconstrained diffeomorphism at large deformation scale
variant_descriptions.chart-fixed: D'Agnese Chart Operator: one learned certified chart (no equidistribution term)
variant_descriptions.chart-eq: D'Agnese Chart Operator + D'Agnese equidistribution loss
variant_descriptions.chart-cond: D'Agnese Chart Operator with a per-sample chart (mesh model) + equidistribution
variant_descriptions.chart-deep: D'Agnese Chart Operator with three composed triangular charts
variant_descriptions.dif-barrier-large: Barrier at large deformation scale (what the barrier buys you)
